title: Form 1099-INT box 3 statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every interest amount reported in box 3 of a Form 1099-INT furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item. This claim covers Form 1099-INT box 3 only: it says nothing about other 1099-INT boxes, interest not reported on Form 1099-INT, or total taxable interest (Form 1040 line 2b).
